original: In the 14th century, for example, what was probably Iceland's most important trading post, Maríuhöfn, was located on the south shore of the fjord near Kjós.
translated: Im 14. Jahrhundert zum Beispiel befand sich der wahrscheinlich wichtigste Handelsposten Islands, Maríuhöfn, am Südufer des Fjords bei Kjós.
